implemented.following_boundary: 오 before vowels, mediating vowels or ㄴ/ㄹ/ㅁ; 옵 before other consonants. Attached formal ㅂ니다 is recovered before the prefinal boundary.
implemented.preceding_boundary: Vowel or ㄹ stems take zero-으 with ㄹ deletion. Other consonant stems take 으 and retain local regular/irregular spelling hypotheses.
implemented.order: Honorific / past (at most twice) / modal → polite → retrospective. Auxiliary and derivation owners remain separate.
implemented.final_bundle: 으리다, from 리다/으리다; distinct from conjectural 으리 + factual 라.

remaining.work: The bundled honorific paradigm and 167 structural attachment/order/ending cases are implemented in tests/optsi.rs. Broader combinations and independent contextual/register review remain open; primary-reference labels do not create KRDict entries.

Additional source-listed following endings and conjectural combinations require their own licenses. The distinct consonant-stem paradigm, contraction and tested tense/modal/auxiliary/derivation paths are implemented; independent Korean review remains pending.

The separate consonant-only paradigm is implemented for reviewed endings. Do not infer formal ㅂ니다 sharing or a vowel allomorph without a verified source; additional combinations and independent review remain pending.

The modern 듣/묻/받/좇 subset, distinct 자오/자옵/잡/자옵시 components and relexicalized whole predicates are implemented and tested in tests/jaop.rs. Twenty-four primary tokens, 336 structural cases and ten dictionary-policy cases are recorded in docs/jaop-evaluation.json. Additional following combinations and independent review remain open; historical coda distributions are not productive modern licenses.

Additional outer-ending compatibility and contextual register remain open. 나이다 and 나이까 combinations now have separate source-backed evaluations; -(으)리까 and its explicit 오/으오/사오 combinations now have a separately tested implementation and evaluation, preserving their distinct source class. Direct omitted copular 이 before 오 + 리까 is now separately implemented and evaluated. Broader omitted polite followers/allomorphs, intervening prefinals and 리까요 remain open. The 리다 final remains distinct from conjectural 으리 + 라.

corpus_search.method: For ordinary token rows in all six pinned UD files, use OrigLemma when present, otherwise LEMMA; align + morphemes with XPOS and select only exact audited forms tagged EP/ep.
corpus_search.caveat: Zero exact EP hits does not prove that the corpora have no polite usage. Broad surface scans include lexical 오다 and final 오; those are not new polite-prefinal gold cases.

label_representation: Canonical 으리다 has no KRDict source ID. The browser links an agent-authored teaching label to the primary NIKL article. The API grammar entry list stays empty; no fabricated dictionary entry or related-entry identity is introduced.

implemented_humble.preceding_boundary: Closed stems, including retained ㄹ, or earlier past/modal markers; consonant-initial attachment creates no vowel-irregular spelling requirement.
implemented_humble.following_boundary: 사오 before vowels/mediating vowels or ㄴ/ㄹ/ㅁ; 사옵 otherwise. Separate 삽 only before consonant-initial endings, without a vowel allomorph.
implemented_humble.order: Earlier honorific/past/modal → humble polite position → retrospective. Distinct paradigms cannot fill the same position twice.
implemented_humble.interpretation: Direct attestations and inferred structural cases remain distinguished. No contextual precision or exhaustive following-ending claim.

implemented_bundled_honorific.boundary: Existing vowel/ㄹ versus other-consonant recovery for (으)옵시; closed-stem 사옵시 retains ㄹ. Local irregular spelling hypotheses stay owned by the actual boundary.
implemented_bundled_honorific.order: Closed bundles explicitly admit earlier past/modal, and allow following endings. Consume one polite quota across the bundle; retain at most two past markers and existing following-ending licenses.
implemented_bundled_honorific.interpretation: Direct primary examples and inferred structural matrices are distinguished. The rhetorical 으려고 past license is preserved; narrower intention composition is separately tested. No independent contextual precision claim.

implemented_lexical_humble.scope: Reviewed modern 듣/묻/받/좇 lexical subset and independently retained whole predicates. No productive historical coda stripping.

implemented_literary_finals.scope: Bare verbal/existential class and source-listed polite/humble retained-ㅂ combinations; copula alternatives preserved.
Separate question rule; source-listed bare classes and polite/humble components. Corpus preservation does not prove new-ending correctness.

implemented_literary_question_ri.status: The eleven baseline-missing direct paths now have their own implementation and 172 candidate cases, ten policy cases and complete native fixtures. See docs/rikka-evaluation.json. Historical 리까요 and omitted-copula polite-prefinal paths remain open.

implemented_omitted_copula_question.scope: Omitted vowel-final copular 이 directly before basic polite 오 + 리까; broader followers/allomorphs remain open.
